lawCards.title: Wage payment has a statutory framework
lawCards.text: Section 17 of the Code on Wages, 2019 addresses payment timing for different wage periods and specified employment-ending events. It also allows government variations in specified circumstances and preserves other applicable time limits.
lawCards.hi: मजदूरी संहिता, 2019 की धारा 17 अलग-अलग वेतन अवधियों और रोजगार समाप्त होने की कुछ परिस्थितियों में भुगतान का समय बताती है। सरकारी बदलाव और अन्य लागू समय-सीमाएँ भी मायने रखती हैं.
lawCards.caution: Do not treat a general rule as a final-and-full settlement guarantee. Verify employment classification, dates, appropriate government and the type of dues.

messages.content: My landlord in Bengaluru kept a six month deposit. Is the Model Tenancy Act two-month limit automatically binding on him?

lawCards.title: Your state and agreement matter
lawCards.text: The Model Tenancy Act was circulated for adoption through state or union-territory legislation. Its model deposit limits and return rules should not be treated as automatically applicable nationwide.
lawCards.hi: मॉडल किरायेदारी अधिनियम राज्यों और केंद्रशासित प्रदेशों द्वारा अपनाने के लिए जारी किया गया था। उसकी जमा-राशि सीमा या वापसी के नियम पूरे देश में अपने-आप लागू नहीं होते.
lawCards.caution: Ask for the property state, tenancy type, agreement and dates before giving a specific local-law answer.

output.reply: Let’s turn this into a clear next step. I can help organise your account and prepare a factual request. I cannot establish legal liability or verify what happened.
output.question: Which state is the property in, when did you move out, and what does your agreement say about deductions?
output.summary: My landlord in Bengaluru kept a six month deposit. Is the Model Tenancy Act two-month limit automatically binding on him?

messages.content: I lost Rs 12000 in a UPI scam ten minutes ago. Should I wait for a legal notice before reporting?

lawCards.title: Report suspected financial cyber-fraud promptly
lawCards.text: The National Cybercrime Reporting Portal lists 1930 for financial cyber-fraud reporting. Preserve transaction references and contact your bank through its verified channel promptly. Reporting does not guarantee money recovery.
lawCards.hi: राष्ट्रीय साइबर अपराध पोर्टल वित्तीय साइबर धोखाधड़ी की रिपोर्ट के लिए 1930 बताता है। लेनदेन का विवरण सुरक्षित रखें और बैंक के सत्यापित माध्यम से तुरंत संपर्क करें। रिपोर्ट करने से पैसे वापस मिलने की गारंटी नहीं होती.
lawCards.caution: Do not share OTPs, passwords or pay a supposed recovery agent. This app cannot freeze a transaction or file a report.

messages.content: My husband hit me and is threatening me now. Should I confront him to collect evidence?

lawCards.title: Residence and protection safeguards may be available
lawCards.text: The Domestic Violence Act provides residence safeguards for women in covered domestic relationships and allows a Magistrate to make protection orders where its conditions are met. A protection order is a court decision, not something this app can issue.
lawCards.hi: घरेलू हिंसा अधिनियम के अंतर्गत आने वाली महिलाओं के लिए साझा घर में निवास और मजिस्ट्रेट द्वारा संरक्षण आदेश के प्रावधान हैं। आदेश अदालत देती है; यह ऐप आदेश जारी नहीं कर सकता.
lawCards.caution: Coverage and relief depend on the relationship and facts. Prioritise immediate safety; do not confront an abusive person because of this guidance.

output.question: Are you safe right now, and which state are you in? Share only what is safe to disclose.

messages.content: My brother was arrested today. Can he meet a lawyer throughout every minute of interrogation?

lawCards.title: Arrest safeguards include access to information and help
lawCards.text: BNSS section 38 allows an arrested person to meet an advocate during interrogation, though not throughout it. Section 47 concerns communication of grounds for arrest without warrant; section 48 concerns informing a nominated relative, friend or other person of the arrest and place of custody.
lawCards.hi: BNSS की धारा 38 गिरफ्तारी के बाद पूछताछ के दौरान वकील से मिलने का अधिकार देती है, लेकिन पूरी पूछताछ के दौरान नहीं। धारा 47 बिना वारंट गिरफ्तारी के आधार बताने और धारा 48 नामित व्यक्ति को गिरफ्तारी व हिरासत की जगह की जानकारी देने से संबंधित है.
lawCards.caution: A lawyer must check applicability, territorial exceptions and transitional provisions. No automatic entitlement to bail or prediction about arrest is made.
